reviewNotes:
Aetherfall is an original 2D pixel-art online role-playing game by Hibira (https://aetherfall.hibira.io). The game client ships inside the app; it connects to our game server, which decides every combat result and reward.

To review: sign in with the demo account below. You start on the Breeze Plains: move with the left stick, attack and use skills with the buttons on the right, and turn on AUTO to let your character fight on its own.

In-app purchases are cosmetic only (outfits and weapon looks) and never change a character's strength. They are sold through Apple In-App Purchase and verified by our server.
